## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) per the DCO (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] New/changed behavior is covered by tests
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md and docs updated if the public API or worker-facing behavior changed
- [ ] A breaking change in the public API bumps the major version
